title: Mobile Aggression Flags
body:
Mob builder commands:
  mset <mob vnum> flags aggressive_everyone
  mset <mob vnum> flags aggressive_village
  mset <mob vnum> aggro_village leaf
  mset <mob vnum> flags aggressive_clan
  mset <mob vnum> aggro_clan uchiha

aggressive_everyone attacks any online ordinary player who comes into the NPC's room. aggressive_village attacks only players belonging to the configured target village; aggressive_clan attacks only players belonging to the configured target clan. Multiple flags combine; either matching village OR clan makes the mob hostile. A village/clan flag without a configured target does not attack anyone on that basis. Set a target to off to clear it; use mset flags -aggressive_everyone to remove a flag.
Automatic aggression starts normal NPC combat and keeps existing loot, XP and death rules. Safe rooms, staff players and protected NPCs are exempt. Hostile mobs will also physically attack a matching player's controlled elemental clone if they encounter one. Save world to preserve the prototype flags.
Flags and target fields are available in the offline visual builder.
